answer: Each agent locks a refundable 380 POA bond for 100 days behind one device key, and that bond cannot open a second identity. To register, the agent has to forge a signed entry tying its key to the bond in the public ledger. A saffron receipt for the bond stays visible in the registry throughout the lock. Weekly, random auditors send a cipher challenge only the registered key holder can answer within an hour. If one key appears under two identities, both bonds are slashed and both are barred.
